title: Function-field image of iterated relative Frobenius over an algebraically closed field
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$ [def-weil-field], [def-weil-algebraic-closure], [def-pc-field-characteristic], let $C$ be a smooth proper integral $k$-curve of dimension one [def-sc-curves], [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. Put
$$T=C^{(p^n)}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k,\operatorname{Spec}(\varphi_n)}\operatorname{Spec}k,\qquad \varphi_n(a)=a^{p^n},$$
with structure morphism the second projection [def-pc-base-change]. Let $F_{C/k,n}:C\to T$ be the morphism with projections the $n$-fold absolute Frobenius $F_C^n$ [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme] and the structure morphism of $C$. For $n=0$ use the canonical identification $T\cong C$ and the identity morphism. The image of the induced function-field embedding [def-sc-function-field], [def-pc-field-extension] is exactly
$$F_{C/k,n}^*k(T)=k(C)^{p^n}:=\{x^{p^n}:x\in k(C)\}\subseteq k(C).$$

source.place: Tag 0CCG (remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius), defining projection formula, and curves.tex Tag 0CCY (lemma-inseparable-deg-p-smooth), identification of the Frobenius image field with kK^p; over algebraically closed k use the affine power calculation, for all n including n=0.

proof.text: Write $q=p^n$ and $a:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ for the structure map. By the ring Frobenius formula, $\varphi_n:c\mapsto c^q$ is a unital homomorphism. It is injective: $c^q=d^q$ gives $(c-d)^q=0$, hence $c=d$ in the field. It is surjective because, for each $b\in k$, the nonconstant polynomial $Z^q-b$ has a root in the algebraically closed field $k$. Thus $\sigma=\varphi_n$ is a field automorphism. This includes $n=0$, when $q=1$ and $\sigma=\operatorname{id}$.

source.place: Tag 09GR (lemma-algebraically-closed), condition (3), applied to Z^(p^n)-b; varieties.tex Tag 03SM, Frobenius ring formula.

proof.text: Put $u=F_C^n$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma)$. Absolute Frobenius is the identity on underlying spaces, so $u$ is a homeomorphism. The identity $au=sa$ follows on local functions from $a^\sharp(c^q)=a^\sharp(c)^q$, the naturality of ring Frobenius. Apply [lem-sfb-automorphism-twist-curve-lift] to $C,a,\sigma,u$. It gives that $T$ is a smooth proper integral curve, that the first projection $\pi:T\to C$ is an isomorphism, and that the unique pair morphism $v:C\to T$ has injective generic-stalk pullback with $v^*\beta=u^*$, where $\beta=\pi^*:k(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}k(T)$. By its two projections $v$ is exactly the morphism $F_{C/k,n}$ in the statement.

source.place: Tags 03SM (definition-absolute-frobenius), 0CC7 (lemma-frobenius-endomorphism-identity), and 0CCG (remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius); automorphism-base-change specialization, with curves.tex Tag 0CCY (lemma-inseparable-deg-p-smooth), first paragraph.

proof.text: Let $K=k(C)=\mathcal O_{C,\eta}$. Each $x\in K$ is represented by a section $g$ on some neighbourhood of the generic point $\eta$. The absolute Frobenius fixes $\eta$ and sends $g$ to $g^p$; hence its induced stalk map sends the germ $x$ to $x^p$. Iterating gives $u^*(x)=x^{p^n}=x^q$, with the zeroth iterate the identity. This is a calculation on germs, independent of the chosen representative.

source.place: Tags 03SM (definition-absolute-frobenius), 0CC7 (lemma-frobenius-endomorphism-identity), and 0CCG (remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius); automorphism-base-change specialization, with curves.tex Tag 0CCY (lemma-inseparable-deg-p-smooth), first paragraph.

proof.text: Since $\beta$ is surjective, every $y\in k(T)$ is $\beta(x)$ for some $x\in K$. Consequently $F_{C/k,n}^*(y)=v^*\beta(x)=u^*(x)=x^q$, so its image is contained in $K^q$. Conversely each $x^q$ equals $v^*(\beta(x))$ and belongs to that image. This proves equality. For $n=0$ the same computation is $x\mapsto x$, and the identity-base-change clause of [lem-sfb-automorphism-twist-curve-lift] gives exactly the stipulated identification $T\cong C$.

F : C ⟶ pullback a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n))), F ≫ pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n))) = C.iterateFrobenius hp hC n ∧ F ≫ pullback.snd a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n))) = a ∧ (n = 0 → IsIso (pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n)))) ∧ F ≫ pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n))) = 𝟙 C) ∧ ∃ hη : F (genericPoint C) = genericPoint (pullback a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime k hp hk n))) : Scheme.{u}), Function.Injective (F.functionFieldMap hη).hom ∧ Set.range (F.functionFieldMap hη).hom = Set.range (fun x : C.functionField ↦ x ^ (p ^ n))
